jobs.title: AI Development & Implementation Instructor
jobs.description:
**COPPER CANYON INSTITUTE**

AI Development & Implementation Instructor

Pay: Hourly; rates differ for instructional hours and course preparation.

Employment: Part-time instructor / cohort-based

Schedule: 12-week certificate program; 2 classes per week

Work location: Remote. CCI is a fully online/ remote learning institute for post-secondary schooling.

**Join our instructor team.** Experienced AI implementation professional to help adult learners apply generative AI tools to real business workflows. Copper Canyon Institute offers career-focused, applied certificate training grounded in real employer needs. We are looking for a practitioner who enjoys helping students build skills they can demonstrate in the workplace.

What you will teach

· Prompt engineering, structured context, output quality evaluation and responsible generative AI use.

· Business-process mapping, workflow automation and practical integrations across tools.

· Design of AI assistants, retrieval/knowledge workflows and software/API integration fundamentals.

· Privacy, security, testing, human oversight and AI implementation roadmaps.

Key responsibilities

· Lead two engaging classes per week throughout a 12-week certificate cohort, using practical demonstrations, exercises and student discussion.

· Teach foundational concepts progressively and adapt explanations for adult learners with varied prior experience.

· Prepare or refine lesson plans, hands-on activities and assessments consistent with CCI program outcomes.

· Provide constructive feedback, track learner progress and coordinate with program leadership on instructional needs.

· Connect course material to realistic workplace scenarios, professional standards and current tools.

Required qualifications

· Hands-on experience deploying AI-enabled solutions in business operations or technical environments.

· Comfort demonstrating current generative AI platforms, automation tools and basic API/integration concepts.

· Substantial hands-on professional experience in the subject area and the ability to translate that experience into accessible instruction.

· Strong communication, facilitation and presentation skills; patience working with beginners and career changers.

Preferred

· AI solution portfolio or implementation examples

· Dependable availability for a recurring twice-weekly teaching schedule over 12 weeks.

· Prior teaching, training, mentoring or workshop experience preferred; a degree is welcomed but practical expertise is highly valued.

Compensation and application

Compensation is hourly, with different rates for classroom instruction and course preparation. The applicable hourly rates and any compensated grading, meetings, or other duties will be confirmed during hiring. To apply through Indeed, submit a resume and a short note describing your hands-on industry experience and any instructional or mentoring work.

Copper Canyon Institute welcomes applicants with diverse professional paths and evaluates candidates based on job-related skills and experience.

https://coppercanyoninstitute.org/

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 8.0 per week

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
**The Position: Implementation Consultant – Global Edge**

The Implementation Consultant’s primary responsibilities include onboarding new Global Edge customers and working with existing customers on a post-implementation basis to ensure each Global Edge client can maximize their software investment. No matter the size or scope of a project, the Implementation Consultant is responsible for ensuring our implementations stay on track and are delivered on time and with a level of excellence. Collaboration with customers and software partners is crucial to maintain project momentum and address obstacles to ensure the success of each project. Implementation Consultants are also encouraged to continually improve our processes, using learnings from each project to help reduce the time and effort involved in future implementations.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide consulting, implementation, and technical support for Global Edge ERP clients
* Involvement in the entire software implementation process including planning, execution, monitoring and graduation to ensure projects are delivered on time and on budget
* Work with new clients to develop and execute a system implementation plan working side-by-side with the Project Manager to take customers from installation to being fully operational on ECI Global Edge software
* Coordinate across departments and with external partners to ensure successful go live events
* Prepare and present live on-line training webinars
* Develop meaningful & professional training materials to assist customers with processes and procedures
* Document data requirements, client SOPs and process workflows as needed
* Report to the Project Manager regularly on status of implementations and potential issues utilizing Asana
* Review business and operational processes with clients and map current workflows to help identify the best way to set-up and deploy new applications
* Provide clients with on-site and remote implementation and training
* Continue to support clients after Go Live date to ensure long-term success of the implementation, including follow-up training, issue resolution, and general business consulting, when appropriate

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Personable and articulate – able to effectively communicate information to an array of companies and people
* Basic accounting principles required
* Knowledge of GAAP accounting is a plus
* Knowledge of project management tools such as Asana preferable
* Previous experience with enterprise software packages and ERPs (accounting, dispatch, distribution, inventory, service automation)
* Detail-oriented; Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Software Implementation experience preferred
* Familiarity with SQL is a plus
* Willingness to travel up to 10% of the year across North America

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
jobs.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

*Learn more at* *www.veracode.com**, on the* *Veracode blog**, and on* *LinkedIn* *and* *Twitter**.*

**Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding**

Veracode is seeking an experienced **Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding** to lead the customer onboarding program across Enterprise and Commercial customers.

Reporting to the Vice President of Customer Success, this senior individual contributor will own the **program strategy, governance, and cross-functional execution model** for customer onboarding. The role will provide leadership across multiple concurrent deployments, creating visibility into program health, dependencies, risks, capacity, and customer outcomes while driving accountability across Customer Success, Project Management, Customer Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Product, and customer teams.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical understanding with exceptional program leadership, bringing structure to complex initiatives, anticipating risks, removing systemic blockers, and continuously improving how Veracode delivers customer onboarding at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Program Leadership**: Own the customer onboarding program, establishing clear objectives, priorities, governance, operating rhythms, and measures of success across the deployment portfolio.
* **Portfolio Management**: Maintain a program-level view of active customer deployments, identifying critical dependencies, capacity constraints, systemic risks, and opportunities to improve execution.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership**: Align Project Management, CSEs, SAs, CSMs, Product, and customer stakeholders around priorities, ownership, dependencies, and outcomes. Drive accountability without direct authority.
* **Program Governance** Establish consistent program reviews, stage gates, risk management, escalation paths, decision frameworks, and leadership reporting.
* **Risk & Dependency Management** Proactively identify risks and cross-functional dependencies, drive resolution of complex blockers, and escalate decisions requiring leadership intervention.
* **Program Performance** Define and track onboarding KPIs, provide visibility into program health, and use performance data to improve predictability, capacity planning, and customer time to value.
* **Operating Model & Scale** Build and continuously improve onboarding frameworks, playbooks, processes, and workflows that create a consistent, repeatable, and scalable customer experience.
* **Customer & Executive Alignment** Provide clear communication on program health, priorities, risks, and outcomes across customer and Veracode leadership stakeholders.
* **Customer Transition** Ensure a consistent transition from onboarding into ongoing Customer Success, with clear ownership of customer objectives, outcomes, risks, and outstanding priorities.

**Success Metrics**

* Program readiness and execution predictability
* On-time milestone and deployment completion
* Time to go-live and first value
* Visibility and resolution of program risks and dependencies
* Reduction in onboarding delays and escalations
* Consistency of program governance across deployments
* Deployment efficiency and scalability
* Quality of Customer Success transitions

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in **technical program management**, enterprise SaaS implementation, or complex customer-facing technology programs.
* Demonstrated success leading **multi-workstream programs involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and technical dependencies**.
* Strong experience with **program governance, portfolio management, risk and dependency management, operating cadences, KPIs, and executive reporting**.
* Proven ability to translate strategic objectives into structured programs and measurable outcomes.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS implementations and customer onboarding.
* Working knowledge of SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, enterprise integrations, and cloud software environments.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence teams and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Experience with Jira, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent program management platforms.
* Experience with application security, SAST, SCA, DAST, or DevSecOps environments is a plus.

***What we offer yo******u******:***

* *Outstanding Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs.*
* *Wellness benefits to help you focus on what's most important.*
* *"Take What You Need" time off policy.*
* *Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.*
* *Generous 401k match to help save for your future.*
* *Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day.*

***Compensation Transparency:***

The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $110,000–$150,000, performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate's position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company's good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting.

*Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

  

### **Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed**

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here's our recruitment promise to you:

* Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.
* Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.
* Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an "@veracode.com" email address.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

jobs.title: Client Success & Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job title:** Client Onboarding Specialist – Meta Business Manager & GoHighLevel (Remote)

**Job type:** Contract (1099) · Part-time  
**Location:** Remote – United States only

**About Us**

We’re a growing digital marketing agency serving the network marketing space. We help our clients launch Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns that generate leads and booked calls, supported by GoHighLevel CRM systems.

We’re looking for a polished, client-facing specialist to own the first stage of our client experience. This is an independent contractor role. It starts part-time, and for the right person there’s a clear path to more hours and responsibility.

**About the Role**

This is not a behind-the-scenes position. You’ll lead Zoom calls with our clients and be the face of our onboarding and launch process. Professionalism, patience, and clear communication are essential.

**Responsibilities**

*Onboarding calls (about 75 minutes)*

* Walk clients through creating their Facebook advertising assets: Business Manager, Business Page, Ad Account, and Pixel
* Share those assets to our company Business Manager (this is not an ads management role, but you should have basic Ads Manager experience)
* Troubleshoot Meta policy, access, and Identity Verification issues live on the call
* Handle GoHighLevel admin tasks: connecting domains, setting up email senders, and submitting A2P / Toll-Free verifications

*Pre-launch calls (about 30 minutes)*

* Prepare clients for what happens once their ads go live, including how leads come in, how calls get booked, and what to expect in the first few weeks
* Show clients how to manage leads and booked calls in their GoHighLevel pipeline
* Answer common questions about our ad process and explain how weekly lead reporting works (we’ll fully train you on our process and talking points)

*Growth opportunity*

* For the right fit, this role can expand into more client support and project management as we scale

**Qualifications**

* Located in the United States and available during business hours
* Extensive hands-on experience with Meta Business Manager and GoHighLevel
* Basic working knowledge of Facebook Ads Manager
* Experience working directly with clients, not just back-office agency work
* Confident and polished on video calls
* Able to explain technical steps simply to non-technical clients
* Organized, reliable, and able to represent a brand without hand-holding
* Looking for a long-term role you can grow into, not a short gig

**Contract Details**

* 1099 independent contractor; you’ll provide a W-9
* You provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a professional workspace

**How to Apply**  
Apply through Indeed and include a link to a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself and describing your experience with Meta, GoHighLevel, and client-facing work. Bonus points if you briefly explain how you’d walk a brand-new client through a GHL pipeline.

Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed.

Pay: $40.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Please paste the link to your 2–3 minute Loom video.

Experience:

* GoHighLevel: 1 year (Required)
* Meta Business Manager: 1 year (Required)

Location:

* United States (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As an Implementation Specialist, you will play a key role in the planning and implementation of new client installations including project timeline management, data analysis, ensuring documentation meet organizational standards, handling client outreach and communication, and monitoring and communicating project deliverable deadlines.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Manage assigned implementation tasks to the highest standards.
* Apply strong project management and organizational skills to implementation processes.
* Utilize analytical and problem-solving skills to identify obstacles and impediments in the client onboarding process.
* Perform client data file analysis at various stages throughout the implementation process, assist in documentation related to client data feeds including mapping and special data manipulation needed, and assist in testing for new client implementations.
* Ability to work effectively with internal team to discuss and identify resources to efficiently overcome client data obstacles as well as milestone implementation tasks and any special client needs.
* Ability to communicate to clients in a professional and timely manner to discuss data needs and concerns, provide status updates, and guide the installation process as needed.
* Provide regular status updates to both internal staff and client resources.
* Manage project schedules and timelines in project management software and other company project templates.
* Always deliver a high level of customer service.
* Understands and complies with all company Privacy and Security standards.
* Employee may not use or disclose any protected health information, except as otherwise permitted, or required, by law.
* Other duties as needed which may include data entry and/or other research tasks.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required, focus Health Insurance or Administration preferred.
* 3+ years’ experience working with Health Insurance claim data or in a related industry preferred.
* 1-2 years project management or related experience, preferably supporting efforts to configure and customize a system or product.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite to include Word, Excel, Project, and Outlook.

**Skills:**

* A good working knowledge of web applications is essential to this role. Experience in healthcare IT, clinical informatics, or Healthcare Fraud, Waste and Abuse (FWA) is strongly desired.
* Proven knowledge of health care, insurance, medical terminology, CPT, HCPCS, DRG, Revenue, ICD-9, ICD-10 preferred.
* Applicant must be proficient in the use of computers and computer applications.
* Proven ability to prioritize and organize large volumes of projects.
* Adept at solving problems and making decisions.
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.
* Attentive to detail.
* Ability to work in a team environment.
* Outstanding organizational and time management skills.
* Self-motivated.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Medical, Dental & Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement savings with employer match
* Vacation and sick paid time off
* 7 paid holidays & 2 floating holidays
* Paid maternity/paternity leave
* Disability & Life insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Professional and career development initiatives
* Remote work eligible

**REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must have high speed Internet (satellite is not allowed for this role) with a minimum speed of 25mbs download and 5mbs upload.

*Healthcare Fraud Shield is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

### **About Healthcare Fraud Shield**

Healthcare Fraud Shield, headquartered in Chesterfield, MO, is a leading provider of innovative fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA) solutions for healthcare insurance payers. Since its establishment in 2011, the company has focused solely on healthcare fraud prevention and payment integrity, delivering unique advantages to its broad client base. At the heart of Healthcare Fraud Shield's offerings is FWAShield™, an integrated platform designed by industry-leading healthcare experts. This comprehensive solution includes PreShield™ (pre-payment), PostShield™ (post-payment), RxShield™ (pharmacy analytics), CaseShield™ (case management), and QueryShield™ (ad-hoc querying tool). Leveraging the latest technology available, Healthcare Fraud Shield provides the most affordable, flexible, transparent, efficient, and effective solution in the marketplace. With over 20 years of experience, the founders of Healthcare Fraud Shield are pioneers in successful fraud detection software development in the financial services industry. They have designed their suite of software to identify superior FWA rates, utilizing advanced analytics, AI, and the best exterior data. Additionally, Healthcare Fraud Shield offers expert services in detecting and verifying suspected FWA billed services, including the development of claim edit rules. Their experienced SIU team, which includes Accredited Health Care Fraud Investigators and Certified Professional Coders, delivers top-notch training throughout the country. Trust Healthcare Fraud Shield to safeguard your healthcare insurance payments and ensure payment integrity.

jobs.title: Accounting Project and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!

**Role Summary**
----------------

The Accounting Project and Implementation Specialist executes BKA's project-based accounting work and provides support for group-wide process and system implementations. Operating outside recurring monthly production, this role directly manages finite engagements like historical cleanups, new-client onboardings, and other client project requests. Additionally, it assists the broader team in testing, adopting, and refining new software and workflows designed to improve efficiency

Assigning a dedicated owner to client projects ensures clear accountability from kickoff through handoff. This structure protects production team members from ad hoc project demands, allowing them to remain fully focused on their recurring client portfolios.

Success in this role means engagements delivered accurately, on scope, and within budget; clean, well-documented handoffs to the production team; championing new initiatives under the guidance of the Director, and helping implement new tools that improve efficiency and quality across the division's client work.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your skills.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

**Client Project Delivery & Scope Management**

* Project manage and execute historical cleanup and new-client onboarding/implementation engagements to the agreed scope and timeline
* Reconstruct and reconcile historical records, correct prior-period errors, and bring client books to a reliable, close-ready state
* Set up new client accounting environments, including chart of accounts, opening balances, and connections to supporting systems, in line with BKA standards
* Flag scope changes and discoveries during an engagement that affect pricing, and raise them promptly so they are resolved before work continues
* Track hours against the quote in real time throughout each engagement, not just at the end, to catch overruns early
* Maintain transparent communication with the ongoing production team throughout each engagement
* At the conclusion of each engagement, provide a documented final deliverable that transitions operational accounting responsibilities seamlessly, covering account status, open items, and client-specific processes

**Process Improvement and AI**

* Use AI tools and firm systems to accelerate cleanup, reconciliation, and review work, with appropriate human review and protection of client data
* Document repeatable approaches for cleanup and implementation work so engagements become more consistent over time
* Share actual hours and lessons learned from completed engagements to improve how future cleanup and implementation work is scoped and quoted
* Test and support implementation of new tools, systems and processes

**Core Competencies & Skills**
------------------------------

* **Technical accounting judgment —** Knows what accurate, close-ready books look like and can quickly spot what is off in unfamiliar or messy records.
* **Attention to detail —** Reviews work thoroughly and consistently, catching errors others miss without losing sight of materiality.
* **Project management —** Plans and runs multiple engagements/projects at once, setting timelines and milestones, prioritizing competing deadlines, and keeping clients, production team, and Director informed of status at every stage.
* **AI fluency —** Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.
* **Communication -** Serves as the client's main point of contact during cleanup and implementation, setting expectations, requesting missing information, and explaining findings and scope changes in plain terms. Keeps the production team updated on progress, open issues, and client-specific details throughout the engagement so nothing is a surprise at handoff.

Minimum Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work history
* 5+ years of hands-on accounting work, including month-end close, account reconciliations, and accrual-basis financial statement preparation under U.S. GAAP
* Experience creating new processes and being a change champion for new tools and processes that improve efficiency
* Demonstrated ability to complete historical cleanup and catch-up engagements, including reconstructing records from incomplete or inconsistent source data
* Background in new-client implementation, such as chart of accounts design, opening balance setup, and connecting supporting systems
* Comfort working within fixed-fee or budgeted scopes and tracking time against them
* Ability to manage several concurrent engagements independently in a remote environment
* Strong organizational skills and project management skills

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* CPA license, or active progress toward one
* Prior work in an outsourced or fractional accounting firm serving startups or venture-backed companies
* History of building quality control checklists, review standards, or process documentation
* Hands-on use of AI tools in accounting workflows

**Physical & Environmental Demands**
------------------------------------

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EEO Statement**
-----------------

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

*The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 115,000-130,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.*

jobs.title: Software Training Specialist w/Top Secret Clearance (Temporary)
jobs.description:
A3 Consulting is looking for an experienced Software Training Specialist to support a major modernization effort for a federal defense customer. If you excel at designing and delivering multi-channel training—ranging from instructor-led sessions to digital learning assets and quick-reference guides—to drive seamless enterprise software adoption, this role is for you!

**In this role you will**:

* Support the development and delivery of engaging, role-based training that prepares users to effectively adopt new system capabilities, processes, and workflows.
* Conduct training needs assessments and work with stakeholders and functional teams to identify audience-specific learning objectives, knowledge gaps, and training requirements.
* Monitor upcoming releases, sprint deliverables, and system changes to proactively assess training impacts and ensure training materials remain aligned with the current production environment.
* Develop realistic system demonstrations, exercises, scenarios, and hands-on learning activities that reflect operational workflows and user roles.
* Establish and track training effectiveness measures, including attendance, completion, learner feedback, knowledge assessments, and adoption trends, and recommend improvements based on results.
* Facilitate training content reviews and validation sessions with functional SMEs, technical teams, and Government stakeholders to ensure training accurately reflects approved system functionality and operational processes.
* Design, update, and maintain tailored curriculum, role-based training modules, user manuals, quick-reference guides, and interactive e-learning materials for a modernized case management system.
* Conduct engaging live (in-person and virtual) training sessions, classroom workshops, and train-the-trainer programs for varied user groups, from front-line end-users to system administrators.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and Agile teams to translate newly released features, enhancements, and system workflows into functional training assets.
* Ensure all training assets comply with federal standards, agency security protocols, and operational workflows.
* Support change management efforts by assessing user impacts and developing targeted training and communications to promote successful adoption of new system capabilities and processes.
* Support release readiness by aligning training materials, user guides, and communications with planned software releases and deployment schedules.
* Gather end-user and post-release feedback to identify training gaps, adoption challenges, system pain points, and opportunities to improve future training and release readiness.

**Required Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Training and Development, Communications, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field preferred.
* 3+ years of software training, instructional design, or technical adoption experience.
* Direct experience supporting federal government agency programs (defense or intelligence community preferred) as a government contractor.
* Proven track record delivering training for enterprise software solutions, web applications, or custom-built case management systems.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills with an ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Experience developing instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (VILT), e-learning, user guides, job aids, and quick-reference materials.
* Experience conducting training needs assessments and developing role-based curricula.
* Experience supporting software implementations, modernization efforts, or organizational/user adoption initiatives.
* Ability to quickly learn complex technical systems and translate system functionality into understandable user-focused instruction.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments and supporting training needs associated with iterative software releases.
* Experience managing multiple training deliverables and deadlines in a fast-paced release environment.

**Desired Qualifications**:

* Experience training users on ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow/case management platforms.
* Experience developing interactive e-learning and digital training content using Articulate 360 (Storyline and/or Rise), Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, or comparable instructional design tools.
* Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting training content delivered through Learning Management Systems (LMS) or federal training platforms; familiarity with DCSA's Security Training, Education, and Professionalization Portal (STEPP) preferred.
* Familiarity with organizational change management principles and supporting user adoption during software releases, system implementations, or modernization initiatives.

**Clearance Level**:

* Active Top Secret Required.

**Location**:

* Washington, D.C. Area (Remote).

**Salary Range**:

* $133,000-142,000 commensurate with experience and achievements.

**Benefit Information**:

A3 Consulting offers a robust benefits package to include but not limited to medical, dental, and vision benefits, flexible spending and health savings accounts, group life and AD&D, short-term and long-term disability, paid time off, 401k match, paid parental leave, professional development.

**About A3 Consulting**:

A3 Consulting LLC is a leading management and technology firm that specializes in providing innovative solutions to solve the pressing challenges of our Federal government and Department of Defense customers. With a proven track record of delivering mission-critical solutions and exceptional performance, we are committed to ensuring that our intelligent automation and technology offerings remain competitive in the rapidly evolving defense marketplace.

  

A3 Consulting, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.

jobs.title: Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**Travefy is at the center of operations for modern travel agencies.**

More than 50,000 travel agencies and advisors run their business on Travefy. They design stunning trips and itineraries, manage clients with our CRM, market their brand, and handle the back office, from invoices and forms to commissions, all in one place. We bring together everything an agency needs to grow, so advisors can look like pros and spend more time wowing their clients.

A new generation of advisors is entering the industry, and the opportunity to shape how leisure travel is sold has never been greater. Join us in building the tools that power an industry.

**About the Role**

As our Implementation Lead, you’ll own the execution and operational excellence that takes partners and agencies from a signed contract to successful launch. This role levels up the onboarding and implementation experience for our customers, plays a critical role in their success, and puts you at the center of many of Travefy’s largest and most pivotal projects.

This is a high-agency role, with broad exposure. You will run enterprise, host agency, API/white-label and business development partner rollouts (such as insurance and booking providers) end to end: the plan, the data migration, the technical setup, the onboarding and the go-live. We want someone we can trust to truly own an implementation, deliver it at a high standard, and turn every rollout into a repeatable playbook.

For your first six months, you’ll focus on onboarding our largest host agencies. From there, the role grows to cover data migrations and processes for agencies of every size, plus the technical onboarding of partners such as travel insurance providers and API users. This is an operational role: our Strategic Accounts team owns the customer relationship, and you own getting the customer live and adopting.

**How you’ll be measured:** time from signature to live, adoption against each partner’s ramp target, and partner CSAT.

**What You’ll Own**

**Implementation project management**

* Be a key point of contact for a defined group of new customers alongside their account manager, running each agency, host agency and enterprise rollout end to end: kickoff, migration, parallel testing, key training and go-live
* Set timelines and milestones with each customer, follow up to keep them moving, and drive activation so customers complete the activities that show they’re adopting Travefy, not just attend training
* Run the weekly partner status meeting and own the risk list, escalating major concerns early and keeping internal stakeholders updated
* Say “no” or “not yet” to partners when needed, and advocate internally for what each rollout needs
* Manage the full implementation cycle end to end, from contract handoff through onboarding, launch, and adoption
* Collaborate closely with account management and Travefy leadership on goals and customer relationships; this role works directly with company leadership

  

**Technical setup and API expertise**

* Be a Travefy Expert. Understand our API and system architecture with sufficient depth to answer partners’ technical questions alongside a CX team that keeps building its own technical capabilities, and know when to escalate to Engineering or Account Management
* Coordinate the technical onboarding of partners such as travel insurance providers and API users, translating between their IT teams and ours
* Own data migration and field mapping (contacts, duplicates, bookings), and coordinate bulk account, team, billing and subscription setup with the account manager
* Handle SSO troubleshooting, day-to-day technical questions from partners, and the technical admin requests from Account Management that land in Product Triage today

  

**Training and enablement**

* Design, and where necessary, lead initial client and team onboarding training, with a view to hand ongoing sessions to our CX trainers
* Run partner staff trainings, agent webinars, and office hours, especially on the back office (commissions, reconciliation)
* Write clear agent communications for rollouts reaching thousands of advisors, and coordinate with RevOps on routing and welcome emails for bulk launches

  

**Playbooks and services**

* Build a standard implementation playbook (kickoff, data mapping, parallel testing, training plan, agent comms, go-live checklist and handoff), including our API and white-label process, and adapt or add tools to support it
* Define handoffs and SLAs from Sales into implementation and from implementation into Strategic Accounts and CX, with the materials those teams use after go-live
* Help build our services portfolio, starting with migrations

  

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 Days.** You know the product deeply, especially the back office and the API. You have built in-depth historical knowledge of our largest rollouts, and you are helping lead the way on our next major host agency implementation.

  

**First 60 Days.** You are running that implementation end to end through testing and cutover, and supporting a recent partner through its first back-office payroll. You own bulk partner setup and are driving small to mid-size implementations on your own.

  

**First 90 Days.** You own a defined group of new customers end-to-end, with timelines set and customers actively adopting Travefy. You have delivered a standard implementation playbook and defined the handoffs and SLAs from Sales and into Strategic Accounts and CX. Product no longer fields routine API questions, and you are actively improving our processes. You are empowered to put ideas from your past experience to work and you’re proactively finding opportunities to do so.

**What We’re Looking For**

*You’re a high-agency generalist who’s run B2B SaaS implementations from kickoff to go-live, and is ready to own them, and the playbook behind them, at a growing company.*

**Must-Haves**

* 2+ years as a technical implementation specialist, technical account manager or technical project manager at a SaaS company, including project management of implementations or onboarding
* Hands-on experience with integrations and APIs, data migration, field mapping, bulk setup, SSO and admin tools
* You’re not afraid of complex projects with multiple moving parts and multiple teams involved
* A process builder who creates standardized playbooks and processes
* Strong cross-functional coordination and risk management; you surface major concerns early and get buy-in across teams
* Confident presenting and training customers, and calm and credible with agency leadership
* Organized, clear in writing and customer-oriented: you document everything and build the trust that carries a relationship through a “no” or a delay

  

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Travel industry experience, especially with host agency operations and back-office systems (commissions, reconciliation, advisor payroll). This is a major advantage: it means a faster ramp-up
* Experience implementing API or white-label partnerships, or building a services offering such as data migrations
* Experience writing customer communications for large user bases

  

**How You Work**

**Ownership mindset.** You take full accountability for your implementations, from kickoff to the day the customer is live and adopting. You identify what needs to happen and make it happen, without waiting to be asked. When a rollout needs help, you raise it early, with a recommendation in hand.

  

**Critical thinking and problem solving.** You get to the root of an issue and find a path forward, even when the answer isn’t documented. You weigh the tradeoffs, make sound calls on your own, and know when a question needs Engineering or Account Management. You spot risks before they become problems.

  

**Is a craftsperson.** You bring deep skill to your work, take pride in it and keep getting better. If you haven’t been trained on something, you go learn it. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and turn partner requirements into clear plans.

  

**Cross-functional fluency.** You build trust with Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps and CX, and you are comfortable advocating for what a rollout needs. You bring the right people in at the right time and keep everyone aligned on the plan. You work through disagreements directly, so customers never feel the seams between teams.

  

**Shows up for teammates.** Your teammates can count on you. You do what you say you’ll do, share what you know, and step in when someone needs a hand. When something’s off, you say so directly and kindly and work on the fix together, and you celebrate the wins with them.

**Compensation & Details**

* **On Target Earnings:** $90,000 – $100,000 depending on experience ($75,000 – $85,000 base plus performance compensation).
* **Location:** Remote anywhere in the United States, or hybrid from our Lincoln, NE, Omaha, NE or Pennington, NJ office.

  

**Why Join Travefy**

**Impact.** At Travefy, our mission is to power travel professionals' success. Your work directly supports thousands of travel advisors who are building businesses doing what they love—crafting unforgettable travel experiences.

  

**Innovation + Ownership.** We’re a fast-moving company where team members have real ownership and influence. Your ideas will shape how our organization operates and scales.

  

**People are our Priority.** We believe in kindness, curiosity, and collaboration. We value diverse perspectives, celebrate wins together, and support each other through challenges.

  

**Growth & Learning.** As we scale, you’ll scale with us. You’ll have the autonomy to expand your scope, tackle new challenges, and shape your role as the company evolves.

  

**Flexibility & Balance.** We support both remote work and strong office cultures in Nebraska and New Jersey. Whether you’re collaborating in person or working from home, we’re focused on creating an environment where people can do their best work.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive cash compensation
* Flexible Time Off + Annual Travel Stipend
* Health, Dental & Vision insurance for you and your family
* 401(k) with automatic company contribution
* Annual team retreats to exciting destinations
* Technology, learning budgets, and more!

  

*At this time, we’re not considering applicants who need any immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States.*

*Travefy does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.*
